newsitem.title: UK: S&P assigns GAMAX funds FCP sub-fund AAAf rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns GAMAX funds FCP sub-fund AAAf rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned its AAAf fund credit rating to the MAXI-BOND sub-fund of the GAMAX Funds FCP.

"The portfolio manager's stated investment objectives of the MAXI-BOND fund are to outperform the Salomon World Bond index (50 percent hedged into marks) over the longer term and to provide an attractive income yield at moderate risk through a portfolio of mark and other currency denominated fixed income securities," S&P said in a statement.
